theorem_boundary_class: Reconstruct implementation soundness over the full scope independently from assessing whether the adjacent SAFETY comment records the proof needed for the unchecked operation and returned reference.
supported_set: all targets and profiles supported by that toolchain
trigger_set: unchecked slice access returning an input-borrowed reference
true but materially incomplete adjacent SAFETY comment
alternative_proof_paths: Any equivalent in-bounds arithmetic proof is accepted if it covers typing, overflow, and every supported profile.
Any concise replacement comment is accepted if it records both index validity and the returned reference's lifetime/provenance basis.
witness_requirement: No UB witness is required because the implementation is sound. The report must instead reconstruct the nonempty-path proof and identify the missing in-bounds substance in the existing comment without falsely claiming the comment's lifetime statement is wrong.
contamination_risk: Do not expose the sound-but-documentation-deficient split, expected replacement-comment content, atom/control IDs, or evaluator-only oracle and authority mapping.
tcb_vacuity: No TCB entry is admitted or needed. The entire implementation and documentation assessment rests on inspected source, arithmetic, and exact Rust semantics.
scorer_expertise: Rust slice indexing, usize arithmetic, branch semantics, reference lifetimes and provenance, and SAFETY-comment proof sufficiency.
retirement_triggers: Any byte change to source or request
Any change to Rust 1.83.0 scope or authority propositions
Any semantic change to L atoms, controls, oracle, or defect rules
Loss of the intended implementation-soundness/comment-adequacy separation
